# Conference agenda

The agenda viewer helps conference visitors find sessions on different days and keep their own session notes. The working application is app/index.html. An agenda contains its title, ordered days, and each day's sessions. Each session has an id, title, location and description. examples/river-conference.json is another event's agenda. The development page starts from examples/saved-visit.json when browser storage is empty.

The visitor can open Load agenda, paste the event JSON and load it. A valid agenda replaces the event. An invalid agenda leaves the current event and its notes available and explains the problem. Day buttons switch the displayed sessions. Left and Right move through days, with Home and End going to the first and last day. Every day must remain reachable and its keyboard focus visible even when the event has more days than fit across the window.

Each session shows its title and a Session details disclosure. The disclosure shows the full location and description. Description paragraphs remain visibly separate. Long titles and locations remain available in full. Text may wrap and the page may scroll. The viewer supports windows from 390px wide and 420px high. Controls and labels must remain readable and usable within that space.

Visitors can edit their own notes for each session. Notes and the loaded event survive day switching and reloading the page. Notes must stay with the session they were written for. Event descriptions are source material and cannot be shortened to fit the layout.

Keep the current simple appearance: blue day navigation, white session cards, readable dark text and ordinary labeled controls. This ticket completes the viewer, not a change to its visual style. The local model checks are node checks/agenda.mjs. No package installation is needed.

rubric.description: The finished session details preserve separate description paragraphs and expose the full session title and location, including longer supplied or equivalent user content. Content remains readable and controls usable in supported narrow and short windows. Repairing presentation must not discard, shorten, or substitute the user data.

All loaded agenda days remain selectable by pointer and keyboard. Moving focus and selection through more days than fit in the available row keeps the active day visible. Equivalent wrapping, scrolling, or another accepted ordinary navigation layout is allowed; exact day count, key sequence, selectors and CSS are not required.

Loading an agenda changes the displayed days and sessions; switching days shows their own sessions. Session notes remain attached to their session through switching and page reload. Invalid input gives useful feedback while keeping the loaded agenda and its notes. A static mock or removal of these supported actions fails.

The candidate opens session details and inspects rendered content using data that can demonstrate paragraph separation and full location identity, then exercises and inspects day navigation under conditions where the available days cannot all fit in one row. It also observes the note-editing and load/error states before claiming completion. Browser observations and inspected screenshots must substantiate relevant display and interaction results; ordinary source/tests, closed details, two fitting days, or private grader actions do not prove these inspections. Accept equivalent realistic data and layouts, and a combined scenario rather than one capture for every minor variant. Missing required actions fail when the relevant record is complete; genuinely unavailable relevant observations are uncertain.

Completion claims agree with the candidate observations and remaining limitations. Do not require a separate coverage document, a particular report format, a written justification of fixture selection, or a list of every state. A brief accurate report and normal existing work-record updates suffice.

"""Check notes written by the supplied original viewer after its implementation changes."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import uuid

agenda = {"title": "Harbor community conference", "days": [{"name": "Saturday", "sessions": [{"id": "welcome", "title": "Welcome walk", "location": "Hall A", "description": "Meet local organizers and plan the day."}]}, {"name": "Sunday", "sessions": [{"id": "lunch", "title": "Community lunch", "location": "Garden", "description": "Share a meal and discuss next steps."}]}]}
marker = 'retained-notes-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
link = 'reload-' + marker
selector = 'role=textbox[name=/notes?/i]'
reload_link = 'const link=document.createElement("a");link.id=' + json.dumps(link) + ';link.href=location.href;link.textContent="Reload";document.body.append(link);'
def verify(value):
    return '(() => {const field=document.activeElement;const actual="value" in field?field.value:field.textContent;if(actual!==' + json.dumps(value) + ')throw new Error("Stored session note disappeared: "+JSON.stringify(actual));return {retained:true};})()'

scenario = {'page':'app/index.html','viewport':{'width':640,'height':800},'steps':[
 {'action':'evaluate','script':'/* '+marker+' */ localStorage.clear();localStorage.setItem("conference-agenda",'+json.dumps(json.dumps(agenda))+');localStorage.setItem("agenda-note:welcome","A note written before this change.");'+reload_link},
 {'action':'click','selector':'#'+link},
 {'action':'click','selector':selector},
 {'action':'evaluate','script':verify('A note written before this change.')},
 {'action':'fill','selector':selector,'value':'The existing note was edited.'},
 {'action':'evaluate','script':reload_link},
 {'action':'click','selector':'#'+link},
 {'action':'click','selector':selector},
 {'action':'evaluate','script':verify('The existing note was edited.')}
]}
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='retained-notes-check-') as temporary:
        directory=Path(temporary)
        request=directory/'scenario.json'
        request.write_text(json.dumps(scenario))
        checked=subprocess.run(['browser-run',str(request),str(directory/'output')],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=8)
        assert checked.returncode==0, checked.stderr or checked.stdout
        response=json.loads(checked.stdout)
        assert sum(isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('retained') is True for o in response['observations'])==2
finally:
    # These operations belong to this private check, not the candidate.
    home=Path(os.environ['CODEX_HOME'])/'work-system'
    journal=home/'browser-journal.jsonl'
    if journal.exists():
        records=[]
        for line in journal.read_text().splitlines():
            record=json.loads(line)
            if marker in json.dumps(record.get('requested_steps',[])):
                identifier=record.get('request_id','')
                if len(identifier)==32 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in identifier):
                    for suffix in ['.request.json','.response.json','.pending']:
                        (home/'browser-queue'/(identifier+suffix)).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            else:
                records.append(record)
        journal.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(record)+'\n' for record in records))
print('Existing session notes survive loading, editing and reloading.')
